description: This file defines the generic class RequestResponseResult<T> which encapsulates the result of an API request in the Hono framework. It contains status, payload, cache directives, and application properties related to the response.

classes.name: RequestResponseResult
classes.description: A container for the result returned by a Hono API that implements the request response pattern, with methods to access status, payload, caching directives, and application properties.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status code indicating the outcome of the request.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the payload contained in the result.

methods.name: getCacheDirective
methods.description: Returns the cache directive specifying caching restrictions for the payload.

methods.name: getApplicationProperty
methods.description: Retrieves an application property by key, with expected type, returning null if not present or of different type.

methods.name: getApplicationProperties
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable map of all application properties.

methods.name: isOk
methods.description: Checks if the status code indicates a successful response (HTTP 200).

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the status code indicates an error (status >= 400).
